description: Public Utilities Commission if Sri Lanka - Notice under Section 10 (3) of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (Amended) Issuance of Certificate of Exemption)
reasoning: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory notice issued under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (amended), providing a Certificate of Exemption from licensing requirements for rooftop solar electricity generation. It establishes regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory conditions for exempted persons, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it deals with regulatory matters and statutory instruments rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
